rows.name: Montana Board of Realty Regulation
rows.mandate: Licenses and regulates Montana's real estate brokers, salespersons, and property managers. Seven members appointed by the Governor with Senate consent — five licensees and two public members (MCA 2-15-1757).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Montana Code; MT publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)

rows.name: Montana Fish and Wildlife Commission
rows.mandate: Sets policy for Montana's wildlife, fisheries, and state parks. Seven commissioners appointed by the Governor with Senate confirmation, one per department region (MCA 2-15-3402).
rows.criticalNote: Curated from the Montana Code; MT publishes no central board-vacancy list (inventory mode)
